label: FLORA C1 — Mask Trap Flat Lay
brief: Overhead flat lay on a white bathroom bench, split down the middle. Left half: a messy pile of mint tins, gum packets, loose wrappers and a travel mouthwash. Right half: the real LACALUT FLORA toothpaste tube (German pack), neat, nothing else. Small CTA-style line beneath the headline, under the right half: "2 steps. Morning and night."
